topic: Parent wrist pain on the thumb side
caption:
Thumb-side wrist pain every time you lift your baby? 👶
Lifting with the thumb spread wide can overload the tendons on that side.

Try scooping with palms and forearms, and get assessed if it doesn't settle.

📍 Chatswood · Sydney CBD
